sampling.eligible: scheduled BTC-5m day plus first/last-30s BBO and book presence and at least one print
sampling.trade_grouping: one transaction hash and economic order group per event, both token prints considered

measurement.branch_A: only if independently bounded per-leg match clock
measurement.pre_quote: latest raw recv_ms < r, then validate 0<bid<ask<1 and finite
measurement.post_quote: latest raw recv_ms <= r+h, then validate
measurement.tie: conflicting same receive timestamp is unknown
measurement.missing: NA with reason, no zero fill

prediction.flow_contract: source print side used only after public side semantics check; never backfill receipt labels into features
prediction.shallow_boosting: HistGradientBoostingRegressor max_depth in [2,3], max_iter=100, learning_rate=0.05, l2_regularization=1; only same richest legal information set
prediction.split: event-time contiguous 50/25/25 train/calibration/late development; purge 35s at boundaries; all legs of event/hash/order stay grouped
prediction.minimum_fit: at least 8 distinct events and 30 complete target legs in each split
prediction.weighting: shares normalized inside event then events equally weighted
prediction.selection: model regularization on calibration weighted MSE only; late segment never tunes

publication_boundary: aggregate only; raw receipts, transaction and order identifiers, row predictions and account data stay private
